subject.title: BL-ecommerce-product-06: product page missing x1.37 reference price fallback when new price is unknown

question: Should this fallback bug be fixed now with newly added BL artifacts, or should it wait for the open Product Page BL block to land its specs/tests first?
rationale: The runtime bug is source-confirmed, but the requested BL spec/test files are absent from dev and the repository BL workflow requires coordinated owner validation.

options.title: Fix with BL artifacts
options.body: Implement the ProductPageB/C fallback and include the matching validated BL spec/test work in the same PR or branch once the Product Page artifacts are available.

options.title: Code-first hotfix
options.body: Land the live UI fallback first and explicitly track the BL spec/test backfill in the Product Page block.

options.title: Wait for BL block
options.body: Keep this bug open until the broader Product Page BL issue produces the validated spec/test structure, accepting the current missing strikethrough in the meantime.

recommendation.title: Fix with BL artifacts
recommendation.body: Implement the ProductPageB/C fallback and include the matching validated BL spec/test work in the same PR or branch once the Product Page artifacts are available.

likelyOwner.reason: MiguelHamelyn is the named Product Page BL owner and the strongest recent feature-history owner for ProductPageB/C.
